Merge PR #284: project-memory: enable policy-gated automatic trusted confirmation

Merge policy-gated automatic trusted confirmation into dev/v2-start.

- Remove forced autoConfirm=false bottleneck from trusted event source orchestrator bridge
- Enable trusted auto-confirm only when requested by trusted source output
- Require verified trusted evidence with event type and source ref
- Require allowlisted auto-confirm policy
- Preserve fail-closed candidate-only behavior when evidence is missing, unverified, or not allowlisted
- Extend smoke coverage for candidate-only, confirmed, and blocked-unverified paths

Boundaries preserved: no AI calls, no Telegram, no raw chat reads, no GitHub/Render/web/source fetching inside module, no source sync, no runtime writes, no repo mutation from module, no env changes, no prompt injection.
